title: Large-universe filtered-colimit continuity of etale cohomology
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X and a filtered category A in Type(u+1), the cocone obtained by applying the derived etale cohomology functor in degree q to a colimit cocone of abelian etale sheaves is a colimit cocone.

source.place: Tags 03Q5 and 0739, with the indexing universe tracked explicitly

proof.text: Repeat the qcqs finite-cover and injective-resolution proof of filtered-colimit continuity, with all objects and morphisms of the filtered index category in Type(u+1). Filtered colimits remain exact and the finite Cech complexes commute with them; induction through the long exact sequences gives continuity in every degree.

Only the smaller-index theorem was found.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleCohomology_isColimit_large_filtered
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    {c : Cocone D} (hc : IsColimit c) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0 ⋙
        Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X (q : ℤ)).mapCocone c))
